releases.name: First Defensible Evaluation
releases.customerHypothesis: One buyer can complete one defensible evaluation with one seller and trust the retained result.
releases.operationalHypothesis: The complete journey is isolated, auditable, recoverable, and supportable.
releases.pilot: One invited buyer and one invited seller in staging.
releases.customerGate: The pilot completes the full journey and retains an immutable auditable result.
releases.operationalGate: Isolation, rollback, recovery, and support receipts pass for one commit.

releases.name: Team Evaluation & Collaboration
releases.customerHypothesis: A buyer team can collaborate on one evaluation without losing ownership, context, or scoring integrity.
releases.operationalHypothesis: Concurrent work, permissions, notifications, and recovery remain reliable under team use.
releases.pilot: One buyer team with at least three roles and two invited sellers.
releases.customerGate: The team completes an evaluation with attributable collaboration and no manual repair.
releases.operationalGate: Concurrency, role enforcement, notification delivery, and recovery receipts pass.

releases.name: Repeatability, Reporting & Operations
releases.customerHypothesis: A returning buyer can repeat an evaluation and produce decision-ready reporting faster than the first run.
releases.operationalHypothesis: Templates, reporting, administration, retention, and support workflows are observable and recoverable.
releases.pilot: One returning buyer repeats a completed evaluation with an operations reviewer.
releases.customerGate: The repeat evaluation and report complete with measurable time saved.
releases.operationalGate: Admin, export, retention, support, and restore receipts pass.

releases.name: Marketplace Supply, Discovery, Matching & Trust
releases.customerHypothesis: Buyers can discover credible sellers and sellers can gain qualified opportunities through trusted marketplace signals.
releases.operationalHypothesis: Supply ingestion, matching, moderation, and trust controls resist abuse and recover safely.
releases.pilot: A bounded category with approved sellers and invited buyers.
releases.customerGate: Pilot users produce qualified matches and report acceptable trust.
releases.operationalGate: Moderation, abuse handling, matching replay, and rollback receipts pass.

releases.name: Intelligence, Scenarios, TCO & Agents
releases.customerHypothesis: Decision intelligence and agents improve evaluation quality or speed without reducing user trust.
releases.operationalHypothesis: Model, tool, cost, safety, and fallback controls are measurable and bounded.
releases.pilot: Opt-in evaluations with baseline comparison and human review.
releases.customerGate: The pilot improves a named decision metric without lowering trust.
releases.operationalGate: Evaluation, cost, safety, fallback, and replay receipts pass.

releases.name: Enterprise Integrations, Compliance, Globalization & Scale
releases.customerHypothesis: Enterprise customers can adopt Sourcera within their identity, data, compliance, and regional constraints.
releases.operationalHypothesis: Integrations, compliance controls, regional operation, and scale targets are proven under failure and recovery.
releases.pilot: One enterprise design partner with agreed identity, integration, compliance, and residency scope.
releases.customerGate: The design partner completes the agreed enterprise journey and accepts the control evidence.
releases.operationalGate: Integration, compliance, residency, scale, rollback, and recovery receipts pass.
